scope.reviewed: The exact body is 7E68..7EA4 (60 bytes, 30 instructions). The 21 isolated fixtures reproduce the returned CRC and each byte-read address for lengths through 257. Instruction flow initializes 0xFF and a 16-bit index, XORs each input byte, performs eight high-bit-conditioned shift/XOR rounds with polynomial 0x31, increments the index modulo 65536, compares that index against the full incoming R1, and returns without a final XOR. The pseudocode matches the instruction sequence.

Candidate files and source match the pinned hashes; isolated replay is byte-identical to the candidate replay JSON.
The 16-bit index wraps while comparison uses full-width R5. Thus lengths above 65535 cannot be reached by the index; this is a decoded termination limitation, not dynamically tested here.

limitations: Only input lengths through 257, accessible synthetic memory and nonconcurrent reads are exercised. Lengths above 65535 may not terminate in ordinary memory as documented.
